xterm.js and @xterm/addon-fit
================================

Vendored unmodified browser builds in this directory:
- xterm.js 6.0.0 — https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
- @xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0 — https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
